parameters.help_en:
The start time of stream merging.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
合流开始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

parameters.help_en:
The end time of stream merging.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
The maximum time difference between the start time and the end time is 7 days
parameters.help_zh:

开始时间与结束时间最大相差7天

parameters.help_en:
The configuration parameters for stream switching.

Triggers a primary-backup switchover immediately when a stream interruption (EOF or network error) occurs.
Triggers a primary-backup switchover immediately if the stuttering rate exceeds 60% in the last 5 seconds.
Triggers a primary-backup switchover if stream pulling times out and no frame data is received for 2 consecutive seconds.
Triggers a primary-backup switchover immediately if no stream interruption or stuttering occurs, but the average frame rate in the last ali_max_no_frame_timeout period is less than ali_low_frame_rate_threshold. If the ali_max_no_frame_timeout parameter is set, the timeout period in Rule 3 is updated to the value of ali_max_no_frame_timeout.
Rules 2, 3, and 4 do not take effect if block_all_jitter is enabled.

Valid values:
10 > timeout > 2
200 > threshold > 1
The value of block is 0 or 1
parameters.help_zh:
切流相关的配置参数

明确发生断流时（eof 或 net err），立刻触发主备切换；
最近5秒内卡顿率超过60%，立刻触发主备切换；
拉流超时，持续2秒收不到帧数据，触发主备切换；
未断流、未发生卡顿，但是最近ali_max_no_frame_timeout时间内的平均帧率 小于 ali_low_frame_rate_threshold，立刻触发主备切换。如果用户设置了 ali_max_no_frame_timeout 参数，则3的超时时间会同步更新成 ali_max_no_frame_timeout。
开启 block_all_jitter 则2、3、4不生效。

取值范围：
10 > timeout > 2
200 > threshold > 1
block的值为0或1
parameters.name: merge_parameters
